scope: Three review-only background/composition edits; no uploads or account writes

items.prompt: Use case: compositing. Image 1 is the sole edit target: the supplied real product photograph of one mother and one daughter in white sleeveless tops and red gingham pants, in a garden by a pale wall. Prepare one horizontal product-ad photograph at 1.91:1, ideally 1536 x 804 pixels and at least 1200 x 628. Change ONLY the background and canvas composition: remove unused blank wall above the hats by reframing, then extend the existing pale wall, ground and garden naturally to the sides. Retain the original two people as unchanged photographic cutouts at the same relative scale and pose. Preserve exactly their identities, faces, hair, hats, sunglasses, hands, shoes, baskets, garment shapes, white top construction, lace/seams, red gingham grid size, grid alignment, fabric texture and colors. Keep both complete outfits and feet inside the frame, without cropping any clothing. Do not repaint, beautify, redesign or regenerate the people or garments. Do not add persons, products, accessories, logos, text, collage panels, borders or blurred duplicate bodies. No bundle claim. Match the original lighting and keep the entire source clothing visually identical. The foreground people and garments are protected; extend the existing background only. Output one image.

Source people and clothing must stay visually identical; only extend the existing background to achieve a clean wide composition. Output one image.
